```yaml
name: Remove Experimental Decorators
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  remove-experimental-decorators:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

      - name: Run experimental decorator removal script
        id: run_script
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S")
          BRANCH_NAME="automated/remove-experimental-decorators-$TIMESTAMP"
          
          # Run the script without dry-run
          python dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py
          SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=$?
          
          if [ $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Script failed with exit code: $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE"
            echo "warning::Script failed with exit code: $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE"
            exit $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE
          fi
          
          # Check if there are changes
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes detected"
            exit 0
          fi
          
          # Create branch and commit changes
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Remove experimental decorators - $TIMESTAMP"
          
          # Push branch
          git push origin "$BRANCH_NAME"
          
          # Create PR using GitHub CLI
          PR_BODY_FILE="/tmp/pr_body.txt"
          cat > "$PR_BODY_FILE" << 'EOF'
## Automated Experimental Decorator Removal

This PR was automatically generated by removing experimental decorators from the codebase.

### Changes Made:
- Removed experimental decorators from various components
- Updated documentation where necessary

### Notes:
- This is an automated update that runs monthly
- All changes are applied directly to the codebase
- Please review before merging

[View the script](https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/blob/master/dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py)
EOF

          gh pr create \
            --title "Remove experimental decorators - $TIMESTAMP" \
            --head "$BRANCH_NAME" \
            --base "master" \
            --body-file "$PR_BODY_FILE" \
            --label "automated"

        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
```
